question: Which country helped develop Chabahar Port?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Chabahar Port** is located in **Iran**, and its development has been significantly supported by **India.** 
• The port holds strategic importance for India as it provides a direct trade route to **Afghanistan** and Central Asia, bypassing Pakistan. 
• India signed an agreement with Iran in **May 2016** for the development of the port. The collaboration includes **investment of $500 million** from India. 
• The operational control of the port was handed over to India in **December 2018**, making it India's first overseas port project.
